purpose: Manual prompts for checking whether the skill description triggers on the intended Fabric validation work and stays out of unrelated tasks.
should_trigger: 이 Fabric 서버사이드 텔레포트 변경을 실제 클라이언트 동기화까지 검증해.
Validate this Fabric custom payload handler and prove the server state changes after the real C2S path.

이 모드는 fabric.mod.json environment가 server야. 멀티플레이 클라이언트까지 포함해서 검증해.

should_not_trigger: 일반 Java 정렬 알고리즘의 시간복잡도를 설명해줘.
expected_behavior: Inspect project versions and existing test setup before choosing API names.
Choose the cheapest validation tier that crosses the behavior boundary.
Do not use packet existence as a gameplay PASS criterion when state can be asserted.
For physical-server-sensitive production loading, prefer Loom production-server verification first; then choose the client-fidelity gate required by the product contract.
Treat Fabric Client GameTest, production Fabric clients, Fabric probes, protocol bots, and unmodified vanilla clients as distinct evidence classes.
Never use Fabric Client GameTest, a Fabric probe, or a protocol bot as proof of an unmodified-vanilla compatibility contract.
Treat Client GameTest as version-sensitive/Experimental and verify exact APIs against the project version.
If an unmodified vanilla-visible behavior cannot be faithfully automated, report BLOCKED or MANUAL GATE REQUIRED rather than relabeling an instrumented test as vanilla.
Do not silently accept the Minecraft EULA.
Keep packet tracing focused and test-only.
